title: If anything: осторожная поправка
description: If anything: осторожная поправка: словарь, грамматическая модель и авторский текст с разбором смысла и объяснениями ответов.
objectives: Понимать if anything как поправку к направлению оценки
notes: If anything, it is slightly slower — если уж на то пошло, немного медленнее.
Оборот не означает отсутствия любых данных; дальнейшие слова задают направление и степень оценки.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: “It is not faster; if anything, it is slightly slower.” What is the correction?

options.label: The tendency is towards being slower, not faster.
There can be no comparison of any kind.

exercises.editorial_answer: The tendency is towards being slower, not faster.
exercises.explanation: Оборот поправляет направление, а slightly ограничивает величину.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: nothing of / anything.

public_payload.sentence: If ___, the revised process is slightly slower.

exercises.editorial_answer: If anything, the revised process is slightly slower.

public_payload.passage: A team expected a revised filing process to save time. After a small trial, the coordinator wrote that it was not faster and, if anything, was slightly slower. A later headline called the trial proof of a dramatic collapse in efficiency. The coordinator objected to the scale and certainty of that claim. Her wording offered a modest correction to the expected direction, based on a limited trial. It neither supported the original promise of improvement nor established a large effect across every future setting. She recommended a larger comparison before deciding whether the procedure should be retained or changed again.

options.label: A dramatic collapse proved in every setting.
A limited tendency towards slightly slower work in the trial.

exercises.editorial_answer: A limited tendency towards slightly slower work in the trial.
exercises.explanation: Slightly и малый пробный запуск ограничивают силу оценки.

lines.text: Does if anything justify replacing slightly with dramatically?
